```{r}
library(gt)
library(tidyverse)
library(maps)
```


**Exercise - Examining the source**

The label of x axis is longitude.
The label of y axis is latitude.

The color of the bird is a tag of the breeding destination of the birds.

The shape represents the type of the site.

**Exercise - Examining the data**

The longitude of the Moscow breeding site is 36.7

**Exercise - Read the first CSV file**

```{r}
bird_breeding_sites<-read_csv("data/breeding_site_locations.csv")
gt(bird_breeding_sites)
```

```{r}
colnames(bird_breeding_sites)
```
```{r}
glimpse(bird_breeding_sites)
```
**Number of rows**

```{r}
print(nrow(bird_breeding_sites))
```
**Number of columns**

```{r}
print(ncol(bird_breeding_sites))
```

**Dimension of the table**

```{r}
print(dim(bird_breeding_sites))
```

**Exercise - Read the seconds CSV file**

```{r}
bird_migration_sites<-read.csv("data/migratory_connectivity_dataset.csv")
gt(head(bird_migration_sites))
```

**Exercise - The glimpse function**

First, use glimpse to print out the data:

```{r}
glimpse(bird_migration_sites)
```

Based on the output above, there are 34 columns and 100 rows in the table.
The data type for the column Tag is <chr>. <chr> stands for character.
The data type for the column Birth is <int>. <int> (or <dbl>) stands for integer (numeric).

**Column Names**

```{r}
colnames(bird_migration_sites)
```

**Selecting columns**

```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```

**Remove duplicate rows**

```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct()

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```

**Rename Columns**

```{r}
bird_breeding_selected <- bird_breeding_sites |>
  select(Site, Longitude, Latitude) |>
  distinct() |>
  rename(Breeding_Longitude = Longitude, Breeding_Latitude = Latitude)

gt(bird_breeding_selected)
```

**Exercise - Select, de-duplicate and rename**

```{r}
bird_migration_selected<-bird_migration_sites|>
  select(Site,
         winterLongitude,
         winterLatitude,
         pslon,
         pslat,
         iblon,
         iblat,
         awestlon,
         awestlat
         )|>
  distinct()|>
  rename(Winter_Longitude=winterLongitude,
         Winter_Latitude=winterLatitude,
         Stopover_Longitude=pslon,
         Stopover_Latitude=pslat,
         Iberian_Longitude=iblon,
         Iberian_Latitude=iblat,
         Westmost_Longitude=awestlon,
         Westmost_Latitude=awestlat
         )

gt(head(bird_migration_selected))
```

**Exercise - Filtering a data frame**
1. Breeding site data excluding Spain

```{r}
bird_breeding_exc<-bird_breeding_selected|>
  distinct()|>
  filter(Site!="Spain")
gt(bird_breeding_exc)
```
2. Migration site data excluding Spain
```{r}
bird_migration_exc<-bird_migration_selected|>
  distinct()|>
  filter(Site!="Spain")
gt(bird_migration_exc)
```

**Grouping and visualising data**

```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc |> group_by(Site)
glimpse(bird_migration_grouped)
```

**Summarize the data**

```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE))

gt(lat_df)
```
Multiple summary statistics:
```{r}
lat_df <- bird_migration_grouped |>
  summarise(
    Highest_Lat_Stopover = max(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Stopover = min(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Stopover = mean(Stopover_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Highest_Lat_Winter = max(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Lowest_Lat_Winter = min(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Lat_Winter = mean(Winter_Latitude, na.rm = TRUE)
  )

gt(lat_df)
```

**Exercise - Summarise a data frame**
```{r}
bird_migration_grouped <- bird_migration_exc|>group_by(Site)

bird_migration_summary<-bird_migration_grouped|>
  summarise(
    Stopover_Latitude = median(Stopover_Latitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Stopover_Longitude = median(Stopover_Longitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Iberian_Latitude = median(Iberian_Latitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Iberian_Longitude = median(Iberian_Longitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Westmost_Latitude = median(Westmost_Latitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Westmost_Longitude = median(Westmost_Longitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Winter_Latitude = median(Winter_Latitude,na.rm=TRUE),
    Winter_Longitude = median(Winter_Longitude,na.rm=TRUE)
  )
gt(bird_migration_summary)
```

**Joining data frames**
```{r}
df_dept <- read_csv("data/depts.csv")
df_score <- read_csv("data/scores.csv")
gt(df_dept)
```

```{r}
gt(df_score)
```

```{r}
full_join_example<-full_join(df_dept,df_score)
gt(full_join_example)
```
```{r}
inner_join_example<-inner_join(df_dept,df_score)
gt(inner_join_example)
```

```{r}
left_join_example<-left_join(df_dept,df_score)
gt(left_join_example)
```

```{r}
right_join_example<-right_join(df_dept,df_score)
gt(right_join_example)
```

**Exercise - Joining data frames**

```{r}
combined_bird_data<-full_join(bird_breeding_exc,bird_migration_summary)
gt(combined_bird_data)
```

**Long and wide formats**
```{r}
combined_bird_piv <- combined_bird_data |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = ends_with(c("_Longitude", "_Latitude")),
    names_sep = "_",
    names_to = c("Location_Type", ".value")
  )

gt(combined_bird_piv)
```

**Exercise - Subset data**
Spring data:
```{r}
keep_spring<-c("Breeding","Stopover","Winter")
spring_data<-combined_bird_piv|>
  filter(Location_Type %in% keep_spring)
gt(spring_data)
```
Autumn data:
```{r}
keep_autumn<-c("Breeding","Iberian","Westmost","Winter")
autumn_data<-combined_bird_piv|>
  filter(Location_Type %in% keep_autumn)
gt(autumn_data)
```
```{r}
write_csv(spring_data, "output/birds_spring.csv")
write_csv(autumn_data, "output/birds_autumn.csv")
```

**Exercise - Adding axes and points**
```{r}
ggplot(spring_data,aes(
  x=Longitude,
  y=Latitude
  ))+geom_point()+
  annotation_borders(linewidth=0.2)+
  coord_quickmap()
```

**Exercise - Calculating axis limits**
Minimum longitude
```{r}
min_lon<-spring_data|>
  pull(Longitude)|>
  min()
print(min_lon)
```
Maximum Longitude
```{r}
max_lon<-spring_data|>
  pull(Longitude)|>
  max()
print(max_lon)
```
Minimum latitude
```{r}
min_lat<-spring_data|>
  pull(Latitude)|>
  min()
print(min_lat)
```
Maximum latitude
```{r}
max_lat<-spring_data|>
  pull(Latitude)|>
  max()
print(max_lat)
```
**Exercise - Setting axis limits**
```{r}
ggplot(spring_data,aes(
  x=Longitude,
  y=Latitude,
  colour=Site
  ))+geom_point(size=3)+
  annotation_borders(linewidth=0.2)+
  coord_quickmap(xlim=c(min_lon-2,max_lon+2),
                 ylim=c(min_lat-2,max_lat+2))
```

**Exercise - Grouping points & Add paths**
```{r}
ggplot(spring_data,aes(
  x=Longitude,
  y=Latitude,
  colour=Site,
  shape=Location_Type
  ))+geom_point(size=3)+
  annotation_borders(linewidth=0.2)+
  coord_quickmap(xlim=c(min_lon-2,max_lon+2),
                 ylim=c(min_lat-2,max_lat+2))+
  geom_path(aes(group = Site)) +
  ggtitle("Pied Flycatcher Spring Migration Routes") +
  xlab("Longitude (°)") +
  ylab("Latitude (°)") +
  theme_minimal()
  
```
